title: Television Broadcast?
content: This was probably three nights back, maybe four. The main (only?) television channel was running a really weird broadcast. It was prefaced by a public alert type noise like before an important warning. The broadcast itself was… weird. There was these things dancing around but they weren’t anything of earth or even this dimension. Like energy beings with these ever changing morphing forms changing in unison together. In front of this group of beings was an object of some sort that I can only explain as fourth dimensional. It wasn’t *in the ground* it was *through the ground* as if it were glitching through it from underneath. It seemed of great importance. I want to say it was a silent video. There was nothing outwardly wrong about the content but the distinct feeling I got from it and even said out loud in my dream was “this is so disturbing but I cat stop watching.” That’s about all I remember, anybody else see something like this?
